result:
I ran all fourteen queries against the input files and each gave a plausible answer. I didn't check any of them against an independent calculation, and nothing was run on the first three W7 and W8 sample lines beyond the output shown.

- **W1:** this returned four names, Anna Weber, Boris Klein, Elena Rossi and Hugo Baas.
- **W2:** the paid total was 199.87.
- **W9:** eng averaged 5067, sales 4200 and ops 3800.
- **W4, W5, W7, W11, W14:** the result keys come back as keywords, with quoted forms like `:"example.com"` where the key has a dot.
- **W11:** it splits each line on `=`, so a value that itself contains `=` would be cut short. None in this file does.

W1: `get /data/users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(get /address | ne null) ~(get /address | has /city) ~(get /address/city | ne null)) | filter ~(get /address/city | lower | eq "berlin") | map /name | sort`
W2: `filter ~(get /status | eq "paid") | map ~(get /items | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100`
W3: `filter ~(get /status | ne "cancelled") | groupBy /customer | map ~(count)`
W4: `get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString) | distinct | sort`
W5: `filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(query /assignee/login "unassigned") | map ~(count)`
W6: `filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | map /labels | flat | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort`
W7: `lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy /2 | map ~(count)`
W8: `lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /2 | eq "api") | map ~(get /-1 | replace "took=" "" | replace "ms" "" | toNumber) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10`
W9: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(get /2 | ne "") | map ~(get {:dept /1 :s ~(get /2 | toNumber)}) | groupBy /dept | map ~(map /s | avg | round)`
W10: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(get /2 | ne "") | map ~(get {:n /0 :s ~(get /2 | toNumber)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /s | desc) /n]) | take 3 | map /n`
W11: `lines | filter ~(startsWith "db.") | map ~(split "=") | map ~(get [~(get /0 | drop 3) /1]) | toMap`
W12: `filter ~(get /type | eq "click") | map ~(query /payload/user/id null) | filter ~(ne null) | distinct | count`
W13: `filter ~(allOf (get /stock | type | eq ::number) ~(get /stock | gt 0)) | map ~(get {:sku /sku :value ~(mulOf /price /stock | mul 100 | round | div 100)}) | sort ~(get /value | desc) | take 3`
W14: `"alice@Example.com, Bob@example.com, carol@test.org, ALICE@example.com, dave@test.org, erin@Test.org, bob@EXAMPLE.com, frank@demo.net" | split "," | map ~(trim | lower) | distinct | groupBy ~(split "@" | get /1) | map ~(count)`
